notes: scan041.N1. Twenty main baselines were read visually, together with the isolated cancelled word, all three inserted phrases/formulas, the authorial 8 and the pale foliation 40. The whole page was used for layout, then each half for line reading. No OCR or external source was used. No independent diagram or drawing occurs.

scan041.N2. The word total is live: its horizontal is a letter crossbar. The isolated cancelled élémentaire lies between main lines 12 and 13 at the left; no attachment leader assigns it to a different location. The separate simple in line 13 and telles in line 20 are also cancelled. All three cancellations are retained without supplying a lost sentence.

scan041.N3. de X attaches after homotopie; K(pi,1) attaches after hypothèses; sur des topos attaches after gerbes and before the one baseline comma. The last insertion has a long curved leader. H loses the first two insertion states and introduces an additional comma around the last.

scan041.N4. Each of the two written equals-like signs represents the shorthand for même. Both are retained as signs, with their lower-bar waviness recorded here. They are not assertions of numerical equality. The two physical occurrences have separate change rows.

scan041.N5. M0958 is resolved as a third reading, coeff, because the gap after the double f has neither s nor dot. The following abbreviation is comm with a comma, not comm. with a stop and not the expanded commutatif. alg likewise has no final stop. The form i.e has its middle dot but no final dot.

scan041.N6. The V in V*_{Y,X} is clearly scripted. The F remains uncertain between calligraphic and fraktur: a hooked cap, slanting stem and middle bar do not establish a printed alphabet. The S exponent in line 12 is retained as 2 at medium confidence: it has a curved cap and short descending right stroke, with no clear horizontal foot, so its visible shape is 7-like. This exact exponent is included in b10 for blind audit. The clear 2s in both H² formulas and (23) were compared; their clearer feet must not be silently projected into this faintly contracted exponent.

scan041.N7. For the stated simplest cell division of S² and constant abelian coefficient group A, the cellular cochain groups are C^0=A, C^1=0, C^2=A, with zero differentials. Thus H²(S²,A)=A. This is a local computation of the target group, conditional on the page's sphere setting; it does not prove the claimed reconstruction from the earlier diagrams.

scan041.N8. The claim that the total homotopy type can be recovered from the diagram is carried as the author's conclusion. Diagrams (7), (8), (10) and (23) are only referenced on this page and are not supplied in this single-page packet, so no proof of that recovery is asserted here.

scan041.N9. The interpretation of H²(X,A) through A-banded gerbes is carried as background in the stated commutative coefficient case. This page begins an argument using recollement but ends in the middle of recolle-; no completed descent proof is supplied or reconstructed.

scan041.N10. The visible text correct, on a, and recolle is readable after enlargement. H's uncertainty wrappers at those places do not produce substantive reading corrections. H's emphasis markup corresponds to the source underline under gerbes. The authorial 8 is present in both witnesses despite different editorial packaging; the pale 40 is another hand. H's end-of-document note is editorial material and is not transcribed as manuscript ink.

scan041.N11. Blind review keeps total, pourrait, singular diagramme, je note and the final recolle- from their visible strokes. It qualifies correct/courant and the two short forms, and makes the existing 2/7 superscript uncertainty explicit in the page. The preferred S² reading still underlies the local H² check; that check does not itself establish the numeral’s ink. The alternative P¹ is rejected because the lower returning stroke belongs to S.
